definitions.gloss: newly appointed; new to a post
definitions.explanation: Having just been appointed to a position, such as a teacher, official, or diplomat.

examples.japanese: {新任|しんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{新任|しんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着任|ちゃくにん}→着任：14905_chakunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new ambassador took up the post.

examples.japanese: ⟦{始業式|しぎょうしき}→始業式：08555_shigyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{新任|しんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the opening ceremony, the new teachers each gave a greeting.

notes:
Common in schools, companies, and government.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新任|しんにん}⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧: a newly appointed teacher
- {新任|しんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: a greeting on taking up a post
- {新任|しんにん}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: a person newly appointed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧: a newcomer, new to the job or field; {新任|しんにん} is new in a particular post and may be experienced

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{信任|しんにん}→信任：11656_shinnin⟧ (confidence, trust, as in a vote of confidence).
